i.norm: Verifies that getSpecifier correctly encodes a RunCodec whose k=1825 and both sub-codecs are BYTE1. k=1825 falls in the [257, 4096] range, so kb=1 and kx = k/16 - 1 = 113. Because neither sub-codec equals the supplied default (runCodec itself), abDef=0, giving first-byte = 117 + kb(1) + 4 + 0 = 122. BYTE1 is canonical codec #1, so each sub-codec specifier is [1]. Expected specifier: [122 (run-codec marker), 113 (kx), 1 (A=BYTE1), 1 (B=BYTE1)].
BYTE1 is canonical codec index 1: BHSDCodec(1, 256)
Build a RunCodec: run length k=1825, both phases use BYTE1
Ask for the specifier; use runCodec itself as the "default for band" so that neither A nor B sub-codec matches the default (abDef=0)
